items.author: genoforprez.bsky.social
items.context: I think games like Stardew or House Flipper or Powerwash Simulator have this relaxing effect on other people. I think there must be a game like this out there for everyone that is more of a brain massage than a game in the classic sense. Just gotta find the one that works for you!
items.text: PowerWash Simulator is a good example, the progress shows with every pass. Agreed there's a game like that out there for everyone.
